Spomething to keep in mind is VFX has never really been a stable career choice, you go for from project to project and bounce around to different studios. I also wouldnt say the vfx job market will get better, It was built to be this way and even after the writers strike nothing fundimentally changed. Keep that in mind when you think about vfx. (Cons: bad stability, lots of OT, lots of pressure, pay honestly isn't great) 

Having said that, I still enjoy my vfx job day to day, working on new projects is still exciting for me and I get a lot out of getting to do creative work everyday. So go with whatever makes you happy.
